project_type: Full-stack Next.js + Express web application (GeoGuessr-like game)
build_system: pnpm workspaces with Next.js (frontend) and Express (backend)
test_framework: Jest for backend, Next.js built-in for frontend validation
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/GeoGuess && pnpm install && pnpm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install at root. 2. Run pnpm run build to verify both frontend and backend compile. 3. Run pnpm run test for backend tests.
setup_instructions: pnpm install at project root sets up all workspaces
environment_constraints: No PostgreSQL runtime available - use SQLite via better-sqlite3. No Docker daemon. Full internet access for npm packages. Node.js v22 available. Use free/open-source map solutions only (Leaflet + OpenStreetMap tiles for guess map, embedded panorama images for street view experience).
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - establish conventions: TypeScript strict mode, ESLint, Prettier, modular architecture
key_patterns: Monorepo with packages/client (Next.js) and packages/server (Express). Shared types in packages/shared. SQLite for persistence. Pre-seeded location database with curated coordinates. Leaflet for interactive map. Custom panorama viewer using static/embedded imagery or Mapillary integration.
directory_structure: Monorepo: root package.json with pnpm workspaces. packages/client = Next.js 14 app with TailwindCSS + Framer Motion. packages/server = Express API with SQLite. packages/shared = TypeScript types shared between client and server.
